blind.description: No text or labels are visible in any of the images. The model is an architectural stone flying buttress featuring a tall upright rectangular pier and a thick curved arch sweeping downward to a separate, lower square footing plinth, leaving an open space beneath the arch. The front face of the tall pier features a sculpted dragon head in high relief with backward-sweeping horns, while the sides feature recessed panels with Gothic architectural tracery moldings. The upper spine of the arch is sculpted with segmented, overlapping dragon scales or dorsal scutes resembling a dragon tail. Surfaces are solid, watertight, and continuous, with no broken shards, spikes, holes, blobs, or thin floating flakes. Nothing is hovering unattached, melted, or fused. The structure stands entirely on its two integrated molded plinth feet with flat undersides resting flush against the floor; there is no added external slab, disc, or ground plinth. Materials and colors consist of hand-painted stylized fantasy stonework with antique bronze/gold trim on moldings, capital, and dragon sculpture, alongside deep crimson/terracotta red panels. There are no plain black or unpainted areas, and no flame or glow.
blind.from_above: From straight above (tile C), the model forms an elongated bracket or dogleg silhouette spanning between two flat stone surfaces. At the bottom is the rectangular top capital of the tall pier, bordered by the protruding snout and horns of the dragon head. Extending upward from the rear of the pier is the segmented, scaly ridge of the arch, which curves slightly to the left before terminating at the square top face of the lower footing plinth.
blind.height_vs_figure: The tall pier stands about 7 ft tall, roughly 1.2 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, while the footprint spans approximately 7.5 by 9 ft across the floor.
